invariants.description: Held by every mode in every family. A mode file that violates one of these is not a Voice Integrity mode. Unlike default_settings, these are not overridable per mode.

pause_between_sentences.note: Range is honored by all 22 modes; field-mode sits at the floor and silent-echo at the ceiling.

signal_priority.description: Degradation order under load. Listed most-expendable first; structure is never dropped.

protocol.defines: What voice should do — the 11-parameter schema.

production.defines: How voice should sound — breath, tone color, pause grammar, texture, dynamics.

synthesis.defines: What generates the sound. External; not specified by this protocol.

accessibility.description: Modes shaped around specific cognitive and sensory needs. The only family in which interruptible is generally true.

endangered_languages.description: Prosodic preservation of at-risk oral traditions. Draft approximations pending community review; see docs/endangered-languages.md.

planned_extensions.sigils: Declared available in v0.1 but never implemented; corrected to false 2026-08-14. Originally proposed in legacy/optional-extensions.md as a symbolic sigil and logic core.
planned_extensions.auditory_trust_calibration: Companion symbolic protocol proposed in legacy/optional-extensions.md. Not built.
planned_extensions.backend_adapter: training/synthesis-targets.json defines conditioning targets, but no adapter to OpenVoice, Coqui, or any other backend exists.

validation.note: tools/validate.py is the authoritative vocabulary for mode parameter enums. Prose docs describe it; where they disagree, the validator wins.
